title: OPP officer shot by cop firearm
article: At least one of the injuries suffered by the Ontario police officer shot in Lindsay this week was caused by a police firearm, the province's Special Investigations Unit said in a statement released Friday.
Const. Keith Calderwood of the Peterborough Lakefield Police Service was injured while executing a drug search warrant on a house in Lindsay on the morning of June 22.
A 21-year-old man, identified as Corey Aaron Armstrong of Toronto, was killed in the bust. Lindsay, with a population of just over 19,000, is about 130 kilometres northeast of Toronto.
